long_biography.plain_text:
Raised inside a Qatari trading house, Alfardan absorbed the pearl expertise of his father, Hussain Ibrahim Alfardan. Business-administration and finance degrees at Webster University in Geneva prepared him for responsibility beyond the original jewellery trade. He subsequently pushed the inherited platform into new sectors and markets around the Gulf, making growth rather than preservation the central succession task.

His present remit joins corporate management with bank governance. The family portfolio now encompasses vehicle distribution, real estate, hotels, currency exchange, investments, marine services and healthcare. Outside it, he is Commercial Bank's managing director, chairs Turkey's Alternatif Bank and serves as vice chairman of United Arab Bank. The combination marks him as an active steward rather than a passive beneficiary.
